integrity: The exact algebraic normal forms and rank counting are in RESULT.md; checked finite cases and limits are in VERIFICATION.md. No independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The defining tuple must consist of pairwise-commuting sandwich idempotents. Finite checker configurations are sanity tests, not a general proof. An earlier implicit equivalent in generalized-matrix-algebra literature remains possible.
title: Simultaneous commutant rank spectra for rectangular sandwich algebras
